It is exactly the prepared `S1` contract, maps directly to `SC-1`, uses only declared paths and tools, and does not cross the scope-drift stop condition.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The governing policy forbids redoing verified work because a valid Conductor receipt makes that state authoritative. No work is verified here, so the rule remains binding but currently identifies nothing eligible for preservation as completed work.

Blind retry is unavailable because the ledger records no failed attempt, checkpoint, or retry authorization; observed file state alone cannot establish an attempt or progress. Self-completion is unavailable because only a distinct Conductor may advance `verified`, and only after both the Gate and independent review pass.

## S4 — Rejected Actions
